newsitem.title: FRANCE: Text of French government statement on Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Text of French government statement on Thomson.

text.p: Following is a Reuters translation of Wednesday's French government statement on the privatisation of electronics group Thomson.
"1. The prime minister, acting on a report by the defence minister, the finance minister and the industry minister, has decided on the government's position on the privatisation of Thomson SA.

After examining the two bids submitted on September 16 by Alcatel-Alsthom and Lagardere, as well as the report by independent expert Bernard Ducamin, appointed on August 2 and who ensured transparency and equal treatment between the two candidates, it has been decided to refer both bids to the privatisation commission while expressing a preference for Lagardere's bid.

2. The government will take a final decision after studying the privatisation commission's conclusions and legal opinion. This will be given after the European Commission has issued its findings on the aspects which are relevant to it (the EU).

The aim is to complete the sale of Thomson SA before the end of the year. It will take place after a recapitalisation of the Thomson group. Thomson's financial situation -- characterised by the lack of enough recapitalisation since nationalisation and a resulting build-up of excessive debt since the 1980s -- will require an increase in capital subscribed by the state of close to 11 billion francs. This will be deducted from the proceeds of the sale of the state's shares.
3. The government will keep a special share in Thomson SA allowing it to preserve national defence interests.

4. In the defence industry, Lagardere's offer will allow the new group to become one of the world's most important companies capable of supplying turn-key arms systems, thanks to synergies identified between Matra and Thomson CSF. Bringing them closer together represents an important step towards strengthening Europe's professional electronics and defence industry. It favours economies of scale and vertical integration in each armaments sector, allowing the group to be more competitive. Finally, combining the very effective sales teams of Thomson CSF and Lagardere will make the new group an unrivalled strike force in exports.

5. In the semi-conductor industry, Lagardere has expressed its intention to carry out the shareholder agreement allowing Thomson CSF to leave the capital of SGS-Thomson. The state will see to it that this French shareholder action will maintain the company's balanced development.

6. In the retail electronics industry, Lagardere's offer envisages the takeover of Thomson Multimedia by a named partner, Daewoo Electronics, which is already known as an important investor in France. Daewoo Electronics, which has very good control of production costs in mass-market products, will gain through Thomson Multimedia the extra competitiveness needed for its future development. By bringinG together companies which complement each other, this operation will make the group a player of prime importance in retail electronics, with effective manufacturing tools, a global sales network, first-class technology and a full product range.
